sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders come into this fixture in excellent form, having won their last match and strung together five consecutive wins before that, though they did draw one of their recent games. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are struggling badly, having lost their last four matches, so Sandbach will be strong favourites to extend their unbeaten run.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) travel to Dawley Town in a match that could have title-race implications if Sandbach slip up. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, are away at Eccleshall (6th place, 18 points) in a direct contest between high-flying teams; Bridgnorth arrive in strong form after a recent win, though they did suffer a loss before that. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points) host Wednesfield Community in another battle between mid-table contenders. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) entertain Foley Meir (13th, 11 points) as the hosts look to maintain momentum after recent wins. Barnton (7th, 15 points) welcome Shawbury United, who are in dire form with five consecutive losses before a recent win. New Mills (8th, 14 points) travel to Market Drayton Town (10th, 12 points), while Crewe host Allscott Heath in a clash of struggling sides. Cheadle Heath Nomads, near the foot of the table, visit Telford Town in a match between the two lowest-scoring attacks in the division. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town in a fixture between teams battling at the bottom; Widnes have just 2 points from 7 games and are in severe distress.
